description: The three bond-additive channels' b3/b2 ~ -1 is the Ursell inversion meeting a bond set, not a three-body finding. Generalised: b3/b2 = n(3)/n(2) - 3 <= 0 for EVERY uniform pairwise-bond model, since n(2) = 1 and n(3) <= C(3,2) = 3.

assertions.name: counts_agree_at_two
assertions.detail: C(2,2)=1 and 2-1=1 -- the deuteron is the one place they agree

assertions.name: pair_deficit_at_three
assertions.detail: 3 pairs vs 2 chain bonds: a deficit of exactly ONE pair, which is the whole of the -b2 below

assertions.name: deficit_widens
assertions.detail: A=4: 6 vs 3, deficit 3 -- not a small-A accident

assertions.name: chain_ratio_is_minus_one_identically
assertions.detail: all 5 bond values give exactly -1 -- the bond value cancels, so this carries no physics

assertions.name: chain_row_is_minus_one
assertions.detail: n(3)=2 reproduces the chain identity from counts alone

assertions.name: all_pairs_row_is_zero
assertions.detail: n(3)=3 gives exactly 0 -- the all-pairs bond set is the boundary case, and it is still not positive

assertions.name: every_uniform_bond_model_nonpositive
assertions.detail: b3/b2 = n(3) - 3 <= 0 for every n(3) <= C(3,2) = 3; measured is +0.6411239316 > 0, so NO uniform pairwise-bond model reaches it

assertions.name: nonuniform_escape_is_open
assertions.detail: w/w_d = 1.213708 (> 1) reproduces the measured value exactly -- so non-uniformity is NOT excluded here, and is the next direction

assertions.name: three_additive_channels_sit_at_minus_one
assertions.detail: ch3/ch4/ch5 all within 0.0321 of -1 (the identity), while ch1 -- the SHIPPED, non-additive channel -- is 0.3995 away and is NOT explained by it

scope: (b) on UNIFORM pairwise-bond-additive binding models, invariant named: the bond count on three nodes is capped at C(3,2) = 3 while the Ursell inversion subtracts three pair terms. (a) on everything else.
caveats: This EXCLUDES NO CHANNEL and refutes no physics. It reclassifies why three already-measured channels failed; the measurement itself is unchanged.

ch1, the SHIPPED channel, is NOT explained by this -- it is not bond-additive (trace prefactor exponential in A) and fails for its own reasons. Check 5 measures that separation rather than assuming it.
NON-UNIFORM bond values are NOT excluded. w/w_d = 1.213708 reproduces the measured value exactly, and that is the surviving direction.
The cap n(3) <= 3 assumes a SIMPLE pairwise bond set. A carrier with genuine 3-body terms, or with multiplicity on a bond, is outside this argument entirely.

The channel b3/b2 values are read verbatim from all-channels-b3-sign.witness.json; their own ~8-significant-figure provenance caveat carries over. Check 5 is a distance-from--1 comparison with margins > 1.3, nowhere near that resolution.
